decisions: Preserve the existing green-and-gold meet identity while replacing congressional-specific branding with Bohol provincial terminology.
Represent every delegation once as a team; derive Elementary, Secondary, and Paragames standings from event divisions.
Match the MVC navigation patterns: use a right-side hamburger drawer on desktop, and retain the icon-and-label floating dock on mobile without a mobile hamburger.

Match the Events page reference with four desktop summary cards and table-style records, plus two mobile summary cards, division pills, collapsible filters, and dark green event cards with gold accents.
Use the CongMeet MVC reports as the source of truth for report configuration, grouping, certification, signatories, print layouts, and Excel exports.
Keep the desktop right-side menu compact and content-fitted, with a neutral translucent scrim that leaves the current page recognizable behind the drawer.
